summary: All six registered investigations are now explained, so this turn records the conclusion rather than running another marginal probe. The last investigation closes on receipt 178cec2b468647b7852512ea21dee4b4: nodes 1, 2 and 5 report accepted 38 and decided 38 while reading index 36 as absent and index 37 as a StopSign, nodes 3 and 4 read index 36 as the StopSign and report accepted 37, and node 4 reports decided 38 with a decided-minus-accepted gap of one. Both declared comparisons on that event are complete and violated, and the observed hole with an inflated accepted index matches the documented sync_log StopSign arithmetic. The remaining uncertainty is stated rather than tested: the exact sync exchange that inflated the accepted index and the exact call sequence that placed the StopSign at the inflated position are inferred from the resulting layout, not observed, and the sealed configuration leaves flexible quorums, batching and snapshot sync unexercised. With the run near its end, another revision of the same seeded schedule would not resolve that uncertainty, so the update keeps the question explained, changes no records and requests no execution.
